gloss: boil-and-drain cooking; cooking in hot water

definitions.gloss: boil-and-drain method; cooking by boiling in excess water
definitions.explanation: A cooking method in which food (especially rice) is cooked in a large volume of boiling water, then drained. For rice, it produces a different texture than the standard absorption method used in rice cookers.

examples.japanese: {湯炊|ゆだ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{炊|た}いた→炊く：02127_taku⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate rice cooked by the boil-and-drain method.

examples.japanese: {湯炊|ゆだ}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{炊飯器|すいはんき}→炊飯器：04972_suihanki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}わ→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧だ。
examples.english: The boil-and-drain method is a traditional way to cook rice without a rice cooker.

examples.japanese: {湯炊|ゆだ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、お⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{湯|ゆ}→お湯：02518_oyu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{茹|ゆ}でて→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}ります→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: In the boil-and-drain method, the rice is boiled in a large amount of water, then drained.

notes:
Combines ⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧ (hot water) and {炊|だ}き (cooking, from ⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧). Contrasts with the standard absorption method ({吸水炊飯|きゅうすいすいはん}) used by modern rice cookers, where rice absorbs an exact amount of water with no draining.

- {湯炊|ゆだ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧: to cook rice by the boil-and-drain method
- {湯炊|ゆだ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧: rice cooked in boiling water
